clips.title: The story
paras: Therylune is cornered by cultists at the Master's Glaive in southern Darkshore. She wandered into its dig sites, and you are needed to guide her to safety and tell her worried sister, Therysil, at the Shrine of Aessina that she survived.

At the Master's Glaive, Therylune is pinned down by Twilight's Hammer cultists. The ravine is dominated by the skull of an ancient monstrosity, pierced by a huge stone blade. Therylune wandered into the heart of the valley despite the dread surrounding it. She survives by reacting quickly and hiding among the rough terrain.

Therysil waits far to the south at the Shrine of Aessina. Her adventurous sister Therylune rarely minds getting dirt on her clothes, but even Therysil was shocked to learn she had ventured into the unwholesome excavations at the Master's Glaive. Word that Therylune is safe will ease her worry. Therysil knows the dark forces digging through Darkshore's ancient earth.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I was wandering around the Master's Glaive, and these dirty cultists surrounded me. Lucky I'm good at hiding!!
Can you help me out of here? And I need to send word to my sister Therysil that I'm all right. She's in Ashenvale to the south, at the Shrine of Aessina.

clips.title: Completion
paras: My sister was where?? Therylune doesn't mind getting herself dirty, but still! That's a long way to wander, and the Master's Glaive is an unwholesome place...
Well thank you, friend. It was very nice of you to let me know she's all right.
